title: S&P Says It May Downgrade Nvidia’s Ratings on Governance Worries
snippet: S&P Global Ratings is looking at cutting Nvidia Corp.’s credit by one notch, citing concerns over the company’s management and governance following the departure, and then the return, of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.
